title: More Big Trees
description: Adds 2x2 versions for every tree in vanilla
body:
## What's added?

2x2 versions of all the vanilla trees.

No fancy tree tops, it's not really meant for decoration (although you can use it for that too). It copies the generation from Spruce and Jungle trees and just changes the blocks:
- **Oak** generates like Spruce
- **Birch** generates like Spruce
- **Acacia** generates like Spruce
- **Azalea** generates like Jungle
- **Mangrove** generates like Jungle
- **Cherry** generates like Spruce

None of the trees are added to **World Generation**.

[Open an issue](https://github.com/TheBlckbird/more-big-trees/issues/new) on GitHub for improvement ideas
